questions.q: What is the role of an insurance broker?
questions.a: An insurance broker is an independent intermediary who represents the client's interests. Unlike an exclusive agent of one company, the broker can compare offers from multiple insurers to propose the best solution for your profile and needs.

questions.q: Why use Leader Assurance rather than going directly to a company?
questions.a: Leader Assurance offers several advantages: access to multiple companies, personalized and objective advice, negotiation of better conditions, claims support, and a single point of contact for all your contracts. Our service is often at no extra cost to the client.

questions.q: Is Leader Assurance an insurance company?
questions.a: No, Leader Assurance is an insurance brokerage and advisory firm. We do not directly bear risks but work with licensed insurance companies to offer you the best coverage.

questions.q: Are you accredited by regulatory authorities?
questions.a: Yes, Leader Assurance is duly accredited in accordance with the requirements of CIMA (Inter-African Conference of Insurance Markets) which regulates the insurance sector in Central Africa, including Cameroon.

questions.q: How do I get a quote?
questions.a: You can get a quote in several ways: by filling out our online form on the Contact page, by calling us at +237 696 41 10 12 or +237 681 80 69 75, via WhatsApp, or by visiting our offices in Akwa, Douala. Our response is generally within 24-48 hours.
Yes, all our quotes and initial consultations are completely free and without obligation. You are not bound by anything until you have signed a contract.

questions.q: How long does it take to subscribe to insurance?
questions.a: Depending on the type of insurance, the time varies. For simple insurance (health, life), subscription can be done in 24 to 48 hours. For more complex coverage (businesses, major assets), the process may take 5 to 10 business days for risk analysis and finalization.

questions.q: Can the contract be modified after subscription?
questions.a: Yes, your contracts can be adapted to the evolution of your needs. Endorsements can be added to modify guarantees, capital or beneficiaries. Contact your Leader Assurance advisor for any modification request.

Absolutely! This is one of our strengths. Each company has specific risks related to its sector, size and activities. We carry out a complete risk analysis to design tailor-made coverage that exactly meets your needs without excess.

questions.q: What types of businesses can be insured?
questions.a: We cover all types of businesses: small businesses, SMEs, large companies, liberal professions, traders, industrialists. Our solutions adapt to all sectors: commerce, industry, services, health, technology, etc.

questions.q: Is professional civil liability insurance mandatory?
questions.a: Professional liability is not always legally mandatory for all professions in Cameroon, but it is strongly recommended for any professional activity. It protects your business against the financial consequences of errors, faults or omissions in the exercise of your activity.

questions.q: What should I do in case of a claim?
questions.a: In case of a claim: 1) Secure people and property if possible. 2) Immediately contact Leader Assurance and/or the insurance company. 3) Gather evidence (photos, testimonies). 4) Fill out the claim declaration within the deadlines set in the contract. Our team accompanies you throughout this procedure.

questions.q: How long does it take to receive compensation after a claim?
questions.a: Deadlines vary depending on the nature and complexity of the claim. For simple claims, compensation can occur within a few weeks. For complex claims requiring expertise, the deadline may be 1 to 3 months. We actively follow each file to accelerate the process.

questions.q: Does Leader Assurance help me in case of dispute with the insurance company?
questions.a: Yes, one of our essential roles is to defend your interests against insurance companies. In case of disagreement or dispute, we intervene as your representative to obtain fair and contractually-compliant compensation.

content.intro: Health insurance is one of the most important protections you can offer your family. In Cameroon, the public health system does not always cover all medical costs, which makes private health insurance essential.

sections.label: The basics
sections.title: What is health insurance?
paragraphs: Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company that pays all or part of your medical expenses in exchange for regular premium payments.

sections.label: Your choice
sections.title: How to choose your coverage?
paragraphs: The choice depends on several factors: your age, your family situation, your general health and your budget. Our advisors at Leader Assurance can help you select the plan best suited to your situation.

content.intro: Cameroonian businesses face many risks that can jeopardize their activity. Business insurance is an essential solution to protect against these hazards.

items.label: Financial risks
items.text: loss of income following a claim.

sections.label: The solution
sections.title: The importance of professional multi-risk insurance
paragraphs: Good business insurance protects you against all these risks in a single policy, simplifying the management of your coverage while optimizing costs.

sections.label: Our role
sections.title: How Leader Assurance can help you
paragraphs: Our team of experts analyzes your activity, identifies your specific risks and offers tailor-made coverage with the best partner companies.

content.intro: The insurance market in Africa is growing remarkably, driven by the emergence of a middle class, digitalization and a growing awareness of the importance of protection.

sections.label: The market
sections.title: The growth of the African market
paragraphs: The insurance penetration rate in sub-Saharan Africa remains low (about 3%), but growth is strong, with immense opportunities for industry players.

sections.label: Local context
sections.title: Cameroon in this context
paragraphs: Cameroon is positioning itself as an insurance hub in Central Africa, with modernized regulation and dynamic players such as Leader Assurance.

content.intro: Choosing insurance can seem complex given the multitude of offers available. Here is a practical guide to help you make the right decision.

sections.label: Your needs
sections.title: Step 1: Identify your needs
paragraphs: Start by listing what you want to protect: your health, your family, your property, your professional activity.

sections.label: Your risks
sections.title: Step 2: Assess your risks
paragraphs: Analyze the risks you are exposed to according to your situation, your activity and your environment.

sections.label: The offers
sections.title: Step 3: Compare offers
paragraphs: Do not limit yourself to a single insurer. Compare the coverage, exclusions and prices of several companies.

sections.label: The broker
sections.title: Step 4: Call on a broker
paragraphs: An independent broker like Leader Assurance can save you time and money by negotiating the best terms for you.

content.intro: Civil liability (CL) protects you when you unintentionally cause damage to third parties. It is a fundamental coverage that every individual and every business should have.

sections.label: The basics
sections.title: What is civil liability?
paragraphs: CL covers the bodily, material or non-material damage you could cause to others in the course of your activities.

sections.label: Individuals
sections.title: CL for individuals
paragraphs: Personal CL covers damage caused by yourself, your children, your pets and, in some cases, your property.

sections.label: Professionals
sections.title: Professional CL
paragraphs: For businesses and liberal professions, professional CL covers errors, faults and omissions in the exercise of your activity.

sections.label: The essentials
sections.title: Why it is essential
paragraphs: Without CL, you will have to personally bear compensation that can reach considerable amounts.

sections.label: The roles
sections.title: The dual role of life insurance

items.label: Savings
